widgets_values: Keep every dark control socket, round well, ring groove and dark screen EXACTLY where it is, pixel-identical, unchanged. Around and BEHIND them, paint ONE flat solid dark-gray SILHOUETTE shape on the pure white background: the outline of {brief}. The silhouette must fully CONTAIN every socket and screen with generous margin on all sides, and its wild parts — horns, fins, tendrils, legs, jaws — grow outward from that mass. Completely flat dark-gray fill, no interior detail, no shading, no outline strokes. Everything else stays pure white.
nodes.title: 2. ENVELOPE pass  —  fal-ai/gemini-3-pro-image-preview/edit  (ENVELOPE_PROMPT)

widgets_values: Restyle this blueprint into a photoreal, wildly-shaped skeuomorphic MP3-player device. CRITICAL: keep the EXACT silhouette, and keep EVERY dark recessed well and screen EXACTLY where it is, same size and shape — every recessed well stays a DEEP DARK EMPTY socket: a near-black matte cavity with a crisp raised rim, NOTHING mounted inside, NOT glowing, NOT filled with material; and every screen — INCLUDING the thin marquee strip — stays switched-off NEAR-BLACK glass, a CLEAN FLAT RECTANGLE never tinted or overgrown by the body material (no text, no graphics). Make the body rich and detailed BETWEEN the wells. Everything outside the silhouette stays pure white. Front-on orthographic, even light, high detail. MATERIAL: polished chrome and brushed gunmetal over dark charcoal plastic, thin green LED accent lines tracing the curves, tiny screws.
nodes.title: 4. PAINT pass  —  same endpoint  (STYLE_PROMPT + MATERIAL[winamp])
(optional) reference-style image  —  MUTED. Un-mute + wire via ImageBatch to ride along in PAINT
(optional) batch envelope + refs  —  MUTED. image1 = envelope, image2 = ref; output → PAINT.images
5. Region alpha mask (white = keep, black = transparent)
5b. mask PNG → MASK (luminance of a channel; mask is grayscale so any channel works)

widgets_values:
SKEUO-UI  —  idea → skin pipeline (ported from src/generate/pipeline.ts)

FLOW:
  1. LoadImage = wells-only blueprint (control layout on white).
  2. ENVELOPE pass  → fal gemini-3-pro-image edit: grow a flat dark-gray
     body silhouette AROUND the wells.            [node 2, ENVELOPE_PROMPT]
  3. PAINT pass     → same endpoint: restyle the envelope into the chosen
     MATERIAL, wells stay empty.                   [node 4, STYLE_PROMPT+MATERIAL]
  4. COMPOSITE      → paint × region alpha-mask = final RGBA frame.

NODE USED FOR THE fal EDIT CALLS: 'Nano Banana Pro (fal)'  (NanoBananaPro_fal)
from the ComfyUI-fal-API pack. Nano Banana Pro IS Google's Gemini 3 Pro Image
model = fal-ai/gemini-3-pro-image-preview — the exact endpoint pipeline.ts calls.
Widgets here are set to resolution=2K, aspect_ratio=2:3, output_format=png to
match falSubmit() in pipeline.ts.

See skeuo-pipeline.comfyui.README.md for install + FAL_KEY setup + caveats.

after 'MATERIAL: ' to switch skin. Current = winamp.

winamp: polished chrome and brushed gunmetal over dark charcoal plastic, thin green LED accent lines tracing the curves, tiny screws.
frog: glossy moulded rubber toy-frog skin in vivid green with subtle mottling, bulging highlights, bright orange plastic hardware accents.
wmp: Windows Media Player 9 / XP Luna capsule hardware: glossy silver-white plastic shells, translucent aqua-blue gel inlays, polished chrome trim rings, soft blue gradients, subtle green LED accents.

nodes.title: MATERIAL presets

widgets_values:
COMPOSITE notes:
• pipeline.ts does: paint × alpha (8-bit L) → RGBA PNG.
• Here: ImageToMask reads the mask PNG into a MASK, then
  JoinImageWithAlpha attaches it as the alpha channel of the
  paint image → RGBA. SaveImage writes a PNG with transparency.
• The mask must be the SAME WxH as the paint output. The paint
  is 2K @ 2:3; render/resize your region mask to match (e.g. an
  ImageScale node before ImageToMask if sizes differ).
• If you don't have a region mask, you can substitute the MASK
  output of a background remover (e.g. a BiRefNet/RMBG node) —
  pipeline.ts deliberately uses a constant region mask instead.
nodes.title: composite

widgets_values:
INSTALL (ComfyUI Manager → Install via Git URL, or clone into custom_nodes/):
  https://github.com/gokayfem/ComfyUI-fal-API
  pip install -r ComfyUI-fal-API/requirements.txt

SET THE FAL KEY (either one):
  • env var:  export FAL_KEY=your_fal_key   (before launching ComfyUI)
  • or edit  custom_nodes/ComfyUI-fal-API/config.ini  → [API] fal_key = ...

ImageToMask / JoinImageWithAlpha / ImageBatch / LoadImage / SaveImage are
COMFYUI CORE nodes — no extra install.

If 'Nano Banana Pro (fal)' shows as a red 'missing' node after install,
update the pack (it was added in the gemini-3 / nano-banana-pro wave); the
fallback is 'Nano Banana Edit (fal)' (NanoBananaEdit_fal) which takes the
same prompt + image_1..image_4 slots.
